title: Nebraska Boating Company, LLC
specs: Veteran owned, family operated with over 100 years combined boating experience
Multiple launch sites including Omaha, Council Bluffs, Carter Lake, Branched Oak Lake, and Fremont
Boater Education Certificate required unless born before January 1, 1985
Operators must be at least 21 years old for jet skis
Operators must present valid government-issued photo ID
Operators must complete online and in-person safety training and demonstrate ability to operate watercraft safely
Pontoon boat operators must be approved by NBC staff before departure
All operators muss pass the related jet ski operator qualification quiz. (3 attempts max per day) Please bring a valid government-issued photo ID.
Coast Guard-approved life jackets are provided and must be worn at all times while operating or riding on the jet ski.
Operators and passengers may not be under the influence of alcohol, marijuana, or any impairing substances.

If at any time you have questions about what actions we take to preserve the natural beauty of the river and nearby lakes and how you can help, please ask!

Nebraska Boating Company may delay, modify, or cancel reservations due to unsafe conditions.
